extraction.name: Self-Contradictory Instructions (SCI)
extraction.description: A multimodal benchmark to evaluate the capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in recognizing conflicting commands. It comprises 20,000 conflicts, evenly distributed between language-language (L-L) and vision-language (V-L) paradigms, across 8 tasks.
extraction.creator: Jin Gao, Lei Gan, Yuankai Li, Yixin Ye, Dequan Wang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is constructed using an automatic dataset creation framework called AutoCreate, which leverages programs and large language models. It starts from manually input seeds and maintains a seed pool. In each cycle, it includes language and vision branches, each with a generator, decorator, and cleaner. Human experts and LLMs are involved in double-checking quality.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: For SemanticConflict, images are retrieved from the ImageNet dataset. For other tasks, data is generated synthetically using LLMs and programs.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For FigureConflict, numerical data is manipulated by changing the maximum value to the minimum value. For SemanticConflict, class names in questions are substituted with similar objects generated by LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A cleaner removes data that does not meet quality standards. Human experts rigorously check the quality of the AutoCreate-generated dataset.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (conflicts) are created automatically by the AutoCreate framework. The decorator creates self-contradictions in the generated data. For SemanticConflict, questions are generated by LLMs and labels are based on ImageNet classes.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Large Language Models (LLMs) and programs within the AutoCreate framework.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Human experts and LLMs are involved in double-checking the quality of the generated dataset. Subsets (SCI-Core, SCI-Base) are selected manually based on conflict frequency.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Provides researchers and practitioners with a standardized platform to assess and enhance LMMs' ability to navigate conflicting instructions, advancing human-computer interaction and communication technologies. Promotes inclusivity in AI research and fosters trust and reliability in AI systems.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Only includes language-language and vision-language paradigms. No fine-grained control to determine conflict degree. No detailed study on attention mechanism of LMMs when confronted with conflict instructions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation of Large Multimodal Models for detecting self-contradictory instructions. Usage guidelines include subsets (SCI-Core, SCI-Base, SCI-All) for qualitative evaluation.
